title: Replace Shot Pattern Results Generated With Superseded Impact Physics
body:
## Problem

Original four 30,000-shot bundles used inconsistent friction physics.

## Acceptance Criteria

Mark historical artifacts superseded; regenerate all final three-club comparisons with source/build receipts.

## Validation

Corrected experiment receipts and matched-seed validation

## Handoff

Branch: `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`. Current implementation and evidence are tracked in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/issues/README.md`. Keep open until a merged implementing PR satisfies acceptance criteria or an explicitly permitted disposition applies.
